verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork supports scheduled/recurring tasks that run automatically on a time-based schedule or on demand (claude-docs-38, claude-docs-58), which is a form of automation, but there's no evidence of user-defined rules triggered by external events (e.g., 'when an email arrives' or 'when a file changes, do X') as opposed to calendar/time-based scheduling. missing for 10: event-driven trigger conditions (webhooks, connector-based event listeners), a rules engine for conditional automation, and any documentation of non-time-based triggers.
